question: Does fitting complete A1 and A2 construction environments identify one fixed rank-one four-head causal coordinate that transfers selectively to capability-qualified v16?

searched: temporal/iswas v15 response, factor, greedy, complement, DAS, and construction-holdout results
v4-v16 is/was builders and capability receipts
canonical temporal dossier, active claims, and current hourly/mathematical reviews
prior_art.known_lessons: Complete-head and exact-factor programs are target-effective but nonselective; a linear P complement destroys construction transfer; target-feasible A1-only DAS beats DIM but fails A2; tested local noise/Jacobian regularization does not improve flips or construction generality.
prior_art.novelty: Fit complete construction environments with hard per-construction licensing and worst-panel controls, then open a third construction exactly once. Rank and regularization are fixed rather than swept.

frozen_design.installation: Ascending-layer unit-dose absolute clamp H_live <- H_base + (H_donor-H_base) U_h U_h^T, with complete attention-15 retained.
frozen_design.crossfit: Train one group parity using both target constructions and both controls; select checkpoints on the opposite parity; repeat directions 0->1 and 1->0.
frozen_design.smooth_training_objective: Mean target match plus squared barriers for the worse A1/A2 projection and direction surrogate, plus the worse differentiable P/C full-vocabulary KL surrogate.
frozen_design.checkpoint_selection: First require every A1/A2 signed projection >= .75 and direction fraction >= .875. Then minimize worst P/C median KL + .25*worst P/C mean KL, followed by max KL, flips, step, and canonical initialization order.
frozen_design.fold_stability: Every head principal cosine across parity-selected projectors >= .75.
frozen_design.sealed_ood: Capability-qualified v16 A1/A2/P is captured and patched only after the v15 checkpoint and initialization family are frozen. V16 C is excluded because its token lengths are not aligned.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_absolute_clam: All frozen hashes and capability ancestry match; v15 A1/A2/P/C and v16 A1/A2/P are rowwise aligned; native/manual, parent replay, factor closure, gradient, orthogonality, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_joint_v15_target_feasible_moved_c: A step-4 or step-8 rank-one checkpoint passes both A1 and A2 target bars in both parity directions.
predictions.pred_c_joint_v15_improves_a2_selectively: Relative to frozen A1-only DAS, A2 signed projection improves by at least .08, A1 remains >= .75, and P/C have zero top-one flips.
predictions.pred_d_joint_projector_is_fold_stable: Every selected head has cross-fold principal cosine >= .75.
predictions.pred_e_sealed_v16_identification_transfe: Each v16 A1/A2 reaches signed projection >= .65 and direction fraction >= .875, and the worse v16 construction beats frozen A1-only DAS by >= .08.
predictions.pred_f_sealed_v16_p_is_selective: V16 P has zero top-one flips and is reported separately; no v16 C patch is attempted.

decision: All predictions passing promotes a fixed-invariant causal candidate and licenses weight-predicted reader reset/rescue. Joint-v15 failure rejects this fixed projector family on observed constructions. Joint-v15 success plus v16 failure selects an input-conditioned or finite-mixture projector whose routing is trained only on v15.
